description: This file defines setup and configuration logic for the 'zalouser' channel in the openclaw project, including account setup, QR login flow, DM and group policies, and wizard configuration.

methods.name: parseZalouserEntries
methods.description: Parses raw string input into an array of trimmed, non-empty entries.

methods.name: setZalouserAccountScopedConfig
methods.description: Sets account-specific configuration for zalouser channel.

methods.name: setZalouserDmPolicy
methods.description: Configures DM policy for a specific account, including allowFrom list if policy is 'open'.

methods.name: setZalouserGroupPolicy
methods.description: Sets group policy ('open', 'allowlist', 'disabled') for a specific account.

methods.name: setZalouserGroupAllowlist
methods.description: Sets group allowlist entries with enabled and requireMention flags.

methods.name: ensureZalouserPluginEnabled
methods.description: Ensures the zalouser plugin is enabled in the configuration, adding it to allow list if necessary.

methods.name: noteZalouserHelp
methods.description: Displays help message about Zalo Personal Account login via QR code.

methods.name: promptZalouserAllowFrom
methods.description: Prompts user to input allowFrom list for DM policy, resolving entries and updating config.

methods.name: promptZalouserQuickstartDmPolicy
methods.description: Guides user through selecting a quickstart DM policy and updates config accordingly.
